name: Lucky Me, Lucky You
source: Okada Nanami is in a serious slump. Her super cute girlfriend just broke up with her, without any explanation, and she's at her wit's end trying to figure out why.  Enter her best friend, Ryo.  In an attempt to cheer her up, Ryo invites Nanami over to his apartment to eat ice cream and watch dodgy porn.  What begins as a perfectly ordinary night, however, soon takes an unexpected turn, when Nanami discovers one of the actresses is none other than Morishita Misae – a has-been pinup model, and Nanami's first crush.  Impulsive as always, Nanami decides to go on a journey with an (unwilling) Ryo to find Misae, and confess to her her feelings – but can her dreams ever hope to live up to reality?
translation: 冈田七海陷入严重低谷。她那超级可爱的女朋友毫无解释地和她分手了，七海绞尽脑汁也想不明白原因。这时，她的挚友良介出现了。为了让七海振作起来，良介邀请她到自己的公寓吃冰淇淋、看低俗色情片。原本平凡的夜晚，却在七海发现其中一名女演员竟是森下美纱江——过气的写真偶像，也是七海初恋对象——后，突然转向了意外的方向。七海一如既往地冲动，决定和不情愿的良介一起踏上寻找美纱江的旅程，向她告白自己的感情——但她的梦想，真的能符合现实吗？
